terra.problem: The line says enemies drove Paul and Barnabas out of Iconium. Acts 14:5–6 says they learned of a plot to mistreat and stone them and fled.
“Driven to Iconium” begins in another district. Acts 13:52 does not say whether the disciples who were filled with joy were in Iconium.
“Stoned in Lystra” happens in Lystra, not Iconium, although some of the Jews involved came from Iconium.
“Timothy’s good name” connects Timothy with believers in Iconium, but Acts 16:1–3 places Paul and Timothy in Lystra and does not say the encounter happened in Iconium.
Words such as “affirmed,” “synagogue,” “disciples,” and “appointed elders” may need simpler wording or brief explanations for a 5th-grade reader.
